name: Sinkmaw
description: The pan's last arrival: it answers you by opening. Not a body on the ground but a hole in it, seen from above — four rings of sand stepping down from a pale rim to a dark throat, grains sliding inward on the slopes, and in the throat two jaws, husk sickles the width of the pit, hinged at the centre and curving out toward +x with the organ lit between them and two ember eyes above it. The game pulls the player toward it (EnemyType.pull) and every few seconds gulps; `gulp` is that beat, played once over it — the jaws clap and the whole funnel contracts and rebounds. The idle `yawn` is the pit breathing, the sand going down. `enraged` puts six legs out of the pit around the rim, cracks the slopes and lights the jaw edges: it comes off the floor and crawls. Never mirrored: a hole has no side, and the jaws face +x only so it has a front for the codex. Gameplay radius 46. The `death` clip clap the jaws open and fills the pit.

enraged.description: Halfway: six rust legs out of the pit around the rim, the slopes cracked, the throat and the jaw edges ember. It comes off the floor and crawls, and the gulps come faster.

yawn.description: the pit breathes: the slopes draw in a little and the sand on them slides toward the throat and goes, the glow in the throat swells, the jaws twitch

gulp.description: the jaws swing wide and clap shut while the whole funnel contracts hard toward the throat and rebounds, the sand on it rushing in and the glow flaring — the beat the pull spikes on

death.description: the jaws clap once and fall all the way open, the throat closes and its glow goes, the pit fills — the slopes flatten out toward the sand's own colour — the eyes go dark and the organ flares out. Enraged, the legs fold in as it fills
